reviews.title: Very good sound; not dependent on software; easy manual controls
reviews.comment:
This is probably the best USB microphone available. It sounds smooth and natural, and it does not require any software to be installed on the computer or iPad. You just plug it in to any computer or tablet or smart phone, and it is recognized as a microphone.
You simply adjust the dials on the microphone to get the right settings, and your headphones connect directly to the microphone so there is no delay in hearing yourself as you speak.
This is significantly better than many USB microphones that rely on software being installed in order to work correctly. Software is always buggy and unreliable. If you update the operating system on the computer or phone, you often lose functionality in this kind of third part audio software. Over time, if the manufacturer stops maintaining the software as happens frequently, your microphone becomes a paperweight.
The Sennheiser Profile microphone simply uses the universal USB audio standard built in to every computer, tablet, and smart phone. The microphone will work for decades into the future.
The sound is smooth and clear and professional. Other USB mics sound thin and tinny. This one does not suffer from that problem.
You can definitely get an even more refined sound from an XLR microphone and stand-alone microphone amplifier (if you know what you're doing), but this mic will sound better than 90% of the cheap USB mics that people are using all over social media.
reviews.author: Charles

reviews.title: Great plug and play microphone for every day use, doesn't rely on software
reviews.comment:
Open the box, connect your mic to your device and done, it's ready for use. I even connected it through my monitor's USB-C port and it works flawlessly through my PC (Windows and Linux) and my laptop (MacOS).
It does sound really great for many purposes such as work meetings and gaming, since it doesn't even need a pop filter unlike many other mics at this price range.
The mic is very sturdy, and has a very minimal and compact design, only light you're gonna see are the mute and volume ones.
Maybe the lack of XLR is gonna be a dealbreaker for some, but for people that want easyness of use, the USB-C port is enough. Getting a mic arm is recommended though (Fifine BM88 is a good one), since the stand is very low and you may need to set your volume higher, capturing more ambient noise.
Around it's price point, you may find some mics that have to sacrifice build material or sound, this one doesn't, so it's pretty good value for money.
reviews.author: Noboru

reviews.title: Great beginner mic
reviews.comment: Great microphone! Good value for its price and quick setup, the quality is good and a great starter mic overall. It looks sleek, it's compact, capable of anything I need - including voice-overs and gaming. I plan on getting a stand soon to mount it on, and it's even capable of that. Very versatile and functional.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.title: Works great once Sennheiser helped diagnose a Windows problem
reviews.comment: This is really well made and my voice sounds fine. I had trouble getting it to be recognized by my new Dell PC running Windows 11. Dell technical support could not help, but the Sennheiser technical help was patient and VERY helpful. Finally traced the issue to a poorly labeled Windows command in Windows/Setting/Sounds/Input. I even had purchased a new SoundBlaster card to power my external speakers using a phono jack. Dell wouldn't help once I added that card, so i removed it. I now power my speakers through the headphone jack on my Sennheiser and everything sounds great.
reviews.author: M. Findlay

reviews.title: Value & Convenience
reviews.comment: Sennheiser - the name to remember for your gear. Sennheiser headphones plug directly into the mic to keep cables organized. Controls face the user. Sound reproduction is clear. I'm totally satisfied with this mic and headphone combination for all my audio/video productions.
reviews.author: JCM
